summary: @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk: static pattern hits in bundled SDK without corroborating exfiltration evidence
details: The package ships a bundled dist/index.js containing multiple POST calls and a string matching a dynamic-DNS keyword. The POST sites are consistent with the shape of an SDK library making HTTP requests to service endpoints; no specific installer-side data read (env scrape, credential file, home directory) is tied to those POST calls, and no attacker-controlled destination hostname is captured in the matched lines. The 'dyndns' token match is a bare keyword hit with no accompanying request bound to a dynamic-DNS host. On the evidence available, this is keyword co-occurrence within a minified bundle rather than a traced exfiltration path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
